content.text:
I took the second seal-stone from the drowned lowest hall of Gemin, so The Vault's Stone is complete. I never fought or sneaked past anyone. The stone was in reach as soon as I travelled to it.

I now carry two of the three stones, the one from Blackrose and this one from Gemin. The Tablet of the Kings says the Eye, if lifted, parts every tree from every other, and if used where it sits, it strengthens them. I never read the tablet myself. The journal summarised it when I took the stone.

The third stone is in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, which is marked. After that, all three go to the Kings Gate at Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth.

Still unknown:
- **Root and Eye:** what they truly are.
- **Ennodius Vanin:** whether he is the real master.
- **Fort Chalkmoth cellar:** what is moaning there. I haven't checked it.

The game accepted my final notes and says it is over.
